import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    N = int(data[0])
    M = int(data[1])
    P = int(data[2])
    MAX = 510

    C = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
    for i in range(MAX):
        C[i][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, MAX):
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % P

    F = [0] * MAX
    G = [0] * MAX
    G[0] = 1

    def C2(x):
        return (x * (x - 1) // 2) % P

    for i in range(1, M + 1):
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            t1 = (C[i - 1][j - 1] * F[j - 1] % P) * G[i - j] % P * (i + 1) % P
            t2 = (C[i - 1][j - 1] * G[j - 1] % P) * F[i - j] % P * (i + 1) % P
            t3 = (C[i - 1][j - 1] * G[j - 1] % P) * G[i - j] % P * ((C2(j) + C2(i - j + 1)) % P) % P
            F[i] = (F[i] + t1 + t2 + t3) % P
            G[i] = (G[i] + C[i - 1][j - 1] * G[j - 1] % P * G[i - j] % P * (i + 1) % P) % P

    DP = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
    Ways = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
    DPold = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
    Waysold = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
    Ways[0][0] = 1

    for i in range(N):
        DPtmp = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
        Waystmp = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]
        limit_j = min(i, M)
        for j in range(limit_j + 1):
            for k in range(j + 1):
                if k == 0:
                    DPold[i][j] = DP[j][0]
                    Waysold[i][j] = Ways[j][0]
                DPtmp[j][0] = (DPtmp[j][0] + DP[j][k]) % P
                Waystmp[j][0] = (Waystmp[j][0] + Ways[j][k]) % P
                rem = M - (j - k)
                val = Waysold[i - k][j - k] * C[rem][k + 1] % P * G[k + 1] % P
                Waystmp[j + 1][k + 1] = (Waystmp[j + 1][k + 1] + val) % P
                val1 = DPold[i - k][j - k] * C[rem][k + 1] % P * G[k + 1] % P
                val2 = Waysold[i - k][j - k] * C[rem][k + 1] % P * F[k + 1] % P
                DPtmp[j + 1][k + 1] = (DPtmp[j + 1][k + 1] + val1 + val2) % P
        DP = DPtmp
        Ways = Waystmp

    ans = 0
    for i in range(M + 1):
        ans = (ans + DP[M][i]) % P
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
